content.text:
rank[index] = place
            self.rank = rank
        else:
            self.lmax = 0
            self.maxwin = 0
            self.all0 = 0
            self.exact = 0

    # -- masks ------------------------------------------------------------

    def mask_for(self, feat):
        """Return (transition mask, completion mask) for a signed feature."""
        entry = self.mcache.get(feat)
        if entry is None:
            fby = self.fby
            buf = bytearray(self.nbytes)
            cell_start = self.cell_start
            cell_bytes = self.cell_bytes
            for depth in range(1, self.lmax + 1):
                starts = cell_start[depth]
                idx = bisect_right(starts, feat) - 1
                if idx >= 0:
                    base = depth * fby
                    buf[base:base + fby] = cell_bytes[depth][idx]
            big = int.from_bytes(buf, "little")
            entry = (big, big & self.exact)
            self.mcache[feat] = entry
        return entry

    # -- fallback tree ----------------------------------------------------

    def eval_tree(self, prefix):
        node = self.tree
        limit = len(prefix)
        while type(node) is tuple:
            index = node[0]
            value = prefix[index] if index < limit else 0
            node = node[2] if value <= node[1] else node[3]
        return node

    # -- decisions --------------------------------------------------------

    def decide(self, flow, reason, when, events, ridx=None):
        if flow.dec:
            return
        if ridx is None:
            cls = flow.fb
            if cls is None:
                cls = self.eval_tree(flow.prefix)
            rule = None
        else:
            cls = self.rcls[ridx]
            rule = self.rid[ridx]
        flow.dec = True
        flow.cls = cls
        flow.rsn = reason
        flow.rule = rule
        flow.at = flow.n
        flow.dtime = when
        flow.prefix = None
        flow.fb = None
        events.append('{"type":"decision","flow":%d,"class":%d,"reason":"%s",'
                      '"at":%d,"time":%d,"rule":%s}'
                      % (flow.fid, cls, reason, flow.n, when,
                         "null" if rule is None else rule))

    # -- time / expiry ----------------------------------------------------

    def advance(self, when, events):
        previous = self.gtime
        if previous is not None and when < previous:
            raise EventError("decreasing time")
        self.gtime = when
        heap = self.heap
        if not heap:
            return
        timeout = self.timeout
        flows = self.flows
        due = {}
        while heap and heap[0][0] < when:
            deadline, fid = heappop(heap)
            flow = flows.get(fid)
            if (flow is not None and not flow.dec
                    and flow.last + timeout == deadline):
                due[fid] = None
        if due:
            for fid in sorted(due):
                self.decide(flows[fid], "idle", when, events)

    def compact(self):
        timeout = self.timeout
        heap = []
        for fid, flow in self.flows.items():
            if not flow.dec:
                flow.hdead = flow.last + timeout
                heap.append((flow.hdead, fid))
        heapify(heap)
        self.heap = heap
        self.heap_cap = max(256, 4 * len(self.flows) + 256)

    # -- flow lifecycle ---------------------------------------------------

    def open_flow(self, fid, when):
        flow = Flow()
        flow.fid = fid
        flow.fwd = -1
        flow.n = 0
        flow.last = when
        flow.matches = 0
        flow.dec = False
        flow.cls = None
        flow.rsn = None
        flow.rule = None
        flow.at = None
        flow.dtime = None
        flow.fb = None
        flow.prefix = []
        flow.win = []
        flow.S = self.all0
        deadline = when + self.timeout
        flow.hdead = deadline
        heappush(self.heap, (deadline, fid))
        self.flows[fid] = flow
        if len(self.heap) > self.heap_cap:
            self.compact()

    # -- packet -----------------------------------------------------------

    def packet(self, flow, when, source, length, events):
        fwd = flow.fwd
        if fwd < 0:
            fwd = source
            flow.fwd = source
            feat = length
        elif source == fwd:
            feat = length
        else:
            feat = -length

        n = flow.n + 1
        flow.n = n
        flow.last = when

        best = -1
        if self.count:
            big, comp = self.mask_for(feat)
            wd = self.wd
            shifted = flow.S << wd
            state = (shifted & big) | self.all0
            flow.S = state
            hits = shifted & comp
            if hits:
                best = self._report(flow, n, hits, events)

        window = flow.win
        window.append(feat)
        maxwin = self.maxwin
        if len(window) > maxwin:
            del window[0]

        if not flow.dec:
            if flow.fb is None:
                prefix = flow.prefix
                prefix.append(feat)
                if len(prefix) >= self.width:
                    flow.fb = self.eval_tree(prefix)
                    flow.prefix = None
            if best >= 0:
                self.decide(flow, "key", when, events, best)
            elif n >= self.plimit:
                self.decide(flow, "packet_limit", when, events)

        if not flow.dec:
            deadline = when + self.timeout
            if deadline != flow.hdead:
                flow.hdead = deadline
                heappush(self.heap, (deadline, flow.fid))
                if len(self.heap) > self.heap_cap:
                    self.compact()

    def _report(self, flow, n, hits, events):
        """Emit every rule occurrence completing at packet *n*.

        Rule indices are handed out in ascending rule-id order, so sorting the
        collected indices yields the required ascending rule-id report order.
        Every rule can only ever complete in the field that matches its own
        length, hence each index appears at most once.
        """
        wd = self.wd
        rid = self.rid
        rank = self.rank
        rlen = self.rlen
        fid = flow.fid
        fired = []
        append = fired.append
        while hits:
            low = hits & -hits
            append((low.bit_length() - 1) % wd)
            hits ^= low
        if len(fired) == 1:
            index = fired[0]
            depth = rlen[index]
            events.append('{"type":"match","flow":%d,"rule":%d,"start":%d,"end":%d}'
                          % (fid, rid[index], n - depth, n))
            flow.matches += 1
            return index
        fired.sort()
        best = -1
        best_rank = 0
        for index in fired:
            depth = rlen[index]
            events.append('{"type":"match","flow":%d,"rule":%d,"start":%d,"end":%d}'
                          % (fid, rid[index], n - depth, n))
            score = rank[index]
            if best < 0 or score < best_rank:
                best = index
                best_rank = score
        flow.matches += len(fired)
        return best

    # -- close ------------------------------------------------------------

    def close(self, flow, when, events):
        if not flow.dec:
            self.decide(flow, "end", when, events)
        events.append('{"type":"closed","flow":%d,"packets":%d,"matches":%d,'
                      '"class":%d,"reason":"%s","rule":%s}'
                      % (flow.fid, flow.n, flow.matches, flow.cls, flow.rsn,
                         "null" if flow.rule is None else flow.rule))
        del self.flows[flow.fid]
